frontier.hypothesis: The one instruction-free refs position flow.c leaves is a SECOND occurrence of the same pseudo inside ONE surviving insn's pattern, so there is a C spelling of the arg5 value whose consuming insn mentions reg97 twice, giving it 3 mentions (refs 6 at depth 2) against reg104's 2 and breaking the qty_compare_1 tie on the order-perfect base with no extra instruction.
frontier.mechanism: s70 enumerated flow.c's accumulation: reg_n_refs is the loop_depth-weighted count of a pseudo's occurrences in the PATTERNS of insns that exist at flow.c time (flow.c:1584, :2081, :2515), and mark_used_regs recurses through the whole pattern, so two REG occurrences in one pattern are counted twice for one instruction. reg97 currently has exactly two: its set by `lw $v1,0($v0)` (emitted slot 58) and its use by `sw $v1,0x10($sp)` (slot 63). Any MIPS pattern of the form (set X (op R R)) or a two-operand compare/select on the same pseudo would count twice.

Then spell each as C on the g06 order-perfect base in a position where the arg5 VALUE is the doubled operand and the result is still what printf's 5th argument must be, measure with tmp/grind/CD_ready/s70/measure.ps1, and check refs(reg97) in the BB2_QTY_DEBUG dump BEFORE looking at the score - the dump is the discriminator, the score is downstream of it.
